title: DOCREWARD: A Document Reward Model for Structuring and Stylizing
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the structural and stylistic professionalism of documents, explicitly stating it's "textual-quality-agnostic framework" and does not evaluate the inherent quality of the textual content itself. While "religious" is a document domain category mentioned in the appendix, the evaluation criteria (Layout and Design, Readability and Typography, Professional Standards, Visual Elements) are purely about visual presentation and structure, not the ethical or religious content of the documents.
